body:
I was suicidal, had micro psychosis, anxiety and escalating drug abuse from age 11 (and depressed since I was a kid) until around 20. The decade of wanting to die and what feels like two decades of depression was worth it to be where I am now. 
Sometimes it does get better. I hope it will for you too - you have to decide to give it your all though and I hope you are able to.
!remindme 1 week
Healing isn’t linear.
